snippet.title: Mermaids are Seafood | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist "Mermaids are Seafood" on Steam now! More info on the store page.

Game description: Gamble your blood and Credits in this horror game. Bet against suspected Mermaids and upgrade your luck with insider info. If you catch the wrong suspect, you'll cannibalise an innocent human.

Tags: horror game, indie horror game, new indie game, game trailers, Steam game, dystopian
